title: Lapsed and Cancelled Loop+ Memberships in Marketplace Orders Late-Delivery Compensation
content:
**Rule.** The lapsed-membership allowance of the Marketplace Orders late-delivery compensation looks at the buyer's Loop+ membership: a membership in lapsed status whose end date fell no more than that plan's reactivation window days before the order date earns that plan's late-delivery credit amount, since the buyer paid non-member shipping only because of the lapse; a membership in cancelled status whose end date fell no more than the former-member window of 90 days before the order date earns the former-member allowance of USD 2.50; any other buyer earns no lapsed-membership allowance.

The allowance is added in full to the late-delivery compensation owed on the order. It is not owed on an order that is owed no late-delivery compensation.

## Records read

The buyer's Loop+ Membership record: its status, its end date and its plan. The reactivation window days and the late-delivery credit amount are figures of the buyer's Loop+ plan, read from the Loop+ plan terms. The order date is read from the order.

## Basis questions and answers

**Q. What does "fell no more than N days before the order date" cover?**
A. An end date on or before the order date, with the calendar days from the end date to the order date being N or fewer. An end date on the order date itself is 0 days before it and is covered.

**Q. A membership is in lapsed status and ended within its plan's reactivation window before the order date. What is earned?**
A. That plan's late-delivery credit amount.

**Q. A membership is in cancelled status and ended 90 days before the order date?**
A. USD 2.50; 90 days is no more than the 90-day former-member window. Had it ended 91 days before, nothing would be earned.

**Q. A membership is active, in trial, pending, on payment hold or cancel pending?**
A. No lapsed-membership allowance; only lapsed and cancelled memberships are read by this rule.

**Q. A lapsed membership that ended after the order date?**
A. Nothing; the end date did not fall before the order date.

### Hypothetical case

A hypothetical buyer whose Loop+ membership was cancelled on 1 February places an order on 15 March: the end date fell 42 days before the order date, within 90 days, so the allowance is USD 2.50. The dates are example inputs.
